# RISC-V ISA

## Concepts

Instruction formats, registers, privilege levels, and the relationship between the ISA and its implementation.

## Implementation

Trace instructions through a small SystemVerilog datapath and identify the corresponding structures in CORE-V Wally.

## Hands-on Experiments

Write small assembly programs and compare expected register and memory values with simulation results.

For each experiment, record the tool versions, design configuration, commands, inputs, expected results, and observed results.
